title: This AI Turns Any Image Into 3D 🤯 #shorts  #ai #chatgpt #coding #aitutorial
description:
🤯 What if one image could become a complete 3D model?

In this video, I showcase TRELLIS, an AI-powered 3D generation tool that can transform images into detailed 3D assets in seconds.

Instead of spending hours learning complex 3D modeling software, AI can help generate a 3D object from an image and give you control over things like output resolution, seeds, and model quality.

In this video:
🔥 TRELLIS AI explained
🧊 Image-to-3D generation
🤖 AI 3D model generation
🖼️ Turn images into 3D
🎨 Generate detailed 3D assets
⚡ AI-powered 3D modeling
💻 Open-source AI tools
🚀 Future of 3D design

This could be incredibly useful for 3D designers, game developers, UI/UX designers, product designers, filmmakers, creators, and AI enthusiasts.
